heading: EXT. FROZEN SEA - STRANDED WHALING SHIP - DAY

units.text: EXT. FROZEN SEA - STRANDED WHALING SHIP - DAY
The hull of a three-masted whaler locked in pack ice.
Rigging furred with rime.
A gale is dying.
The light is low and silver.
On the listing deck, ANNIKA LUND, 30s, wrapped in oilskins, tends a tin stove.
OLEG VARGA, 50s, harpooner's shoulders, gaunt, feeds splinters into the flame.
DR. PELL, 60s, round spectacles, shivers under a sealskin blanket and counts tins of beans.
A figure appears on the ice, dragging a sled.
He stops at the rail.
Tall, bearded, hollow-cheeked, frost in his beard.
Is there room by the fire?
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Who are you?
units.name: ANNIKA

units.text: A man who walked a long way.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: No one walks on this ice.
units.name: OLEG

units.text: I did.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Annika, let him up. He's half dead.
units.name: DR. PELL

units.text: Annika lowers the rifle.
Oleg throws down a rope.
The stranger climbs, crumples on the deck.
Annika drapes a coat over him.
Do you have a name?
units.name: ANNIKA

units.text: Hollis. Matthew Hollis. Third mate of the Albatross.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: The Albatross went down in March.
units.name: DR. PELL

units.text: Four of us got to the ice. I'm what's left.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Four? Where are the others?
units.name: OLEG

units.text: Hollis stares into the stove.
Does not answer.
Beans, Mr. Hollis?
units.name: DR. PELL

units.text: Please.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Pell hands him a tin and a spoon.
Hollis eats slowly, like a man learning how.
Oleg. Make room.
units.name: ANNIKA

units.text: Oleg shifts over without a word.
Hollis settles against the mast, eyes half shut, the fire on his face.
How far is the coast?
units.name: OLEG

units.text: Two weeks. If the ice holds.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: And if it doesn't?
units.name: DR. PELL

units.text: Then you've already had your supper.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Annika almost laughs.
Oleg looks away.
The stove ticks.
